answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a stake-and-seasoning bond. First, a new identity locks 500 tokens for 90 days before earning. Second, it completes 20 verified tasks graded by peers, building a public record. Third, if two identities submit identical work or share a signing key, both bonds are slashed and burned. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 500,000 locked tokens plus 20,000 tasks of work, while one honest sparrow reaches the zenith on a clean record. Without the bond a swarm is noise; with it, every fake voice pays for its signal, like a choir where each singer buys a seat.
